entries.grounds: mutant_view confirms L286: `f" ({'; '.join(cov.reasons)[:300]})"` -> `f" ({'; '.join(cov.reasons)[:300]}"`, dropping the closing ')' of the coverage detail returned as _ocr's third value. The status and every reason stay intact and '; '-delimited; the 300-char cut precedes the parenthesis. Nothing is appended after it on the path that returns it: the parenthesis exists only when cov.reasons is non-empty, i.e. status INDETERMINATE (COMPLETE iff no reasons, review_ocr.py:143). Under fix-loop an INDETERMINATE review raises at adapters.py:283-284 (and a provider failure raises ProviderOutage) and never returns the detail; so a returned paren'd detail occurs only under advisory, where review_verify.blocks is False for every finding (it requires policy=='fix-loop', review_verify.py:332-335) -> confirmed=0 -> no ', confirmed=' suffix (adapters.py:170), and ', parsed=' is skipped for ocr (:169 `if not ocr`). So the unclosed parenthesis is always at the very end of the detail; nothing tokenises it. AUDITED.

EVIDENCE.json hashes the stream as written (run.py:425-434); only RUN.json is canonically re-serialised, so no digest is recomputed over another serialisation. sort_keys=False cannot raise (all keys str) and, ensure_ascii default, emits no raw LF/U+2028, so no record boundary moves.
